@graph.name: Alarm signals

provenance.section_title: Goal 6: Reduce patient harm associated with clinical alarm systems

rules.rationale: Alarm signals can compromise patient safety if not properly managed.
rules.citation: Clinical alarm systems are intended to alert caregivers of potential patient problems, but if they are not properly managed, they can compromise patient safety.

@graph.name: Alarm noise and alarm fatigue

provenance.section_title: Goal 6: Reduce patient harm associated with clinical alarm systems

rules.rationale: Alarm noise and alarm fatigue can cause staff to miss or ignore alarm signals.
rules.citation: At the same time, many patient care areas have numerous alarm signals and the resulting noise and displayed information tends to desensitize staff and cause them to miss or ignore alarm signals.
